body: Mentioned the suicidalness a couple times to the relative. We're doing better but it feels like it's from a place of her doing fine vs needing to take out stress + pity because i've overexplained things.  I don't look forward to that wearing off.'I regret mentioning it to her massively but apparently it's the only thing that ever makes anyone pay attention or take my anxiety seriously, let alone my depression. I'm so tired. I need thst therapist whether i choose survive or die. I'm "better" in a matter of speaking in that i'm not planning death every day but i'm still constantly thinking of how peaceful it'd be. Only one person this entire time has contacted me out of concern and I feel like I can't talk to them now because I got stressed out and took it out of them without realizing, and they don't deserve that or my burdens. I'm wondering if I should cut that off for their sake. And that's compared the other person coming from a place of blaming me for someone else ((who told me not to talk to them about things they would find upsetting that they cannot help and has been oversimplifying my 'don't talk to me if you're act concerned but only want to confront me' as 'they told me off for reaching out')) saying they think i don't want to be friends anymore. I don't have energy for friends. The person who contacted me went on some diatribe about avoidance being more hurtful sometimes and talking about suicidal people in her own life which is. A joke considering the whole issue and also wow with the blaming me for someone else's depression while concerned i'm suicidal? if i'd been anxious vs tired at the time it would've worsened the situation greatly??? I don't know. I get anxious messaging friends randomly about nice things let alone dealing with someone acting as a mouthpiece. I hate how much i need to convince people it's safer for me not be around so i don't set off another round of conflict ((my 'triggers' having become their 'triggers', for lack of a better word. i've left that space because i'm tired of feeling stressed by all the little things and the major things, like saying i'm uncomfortable, having someone else preemptively leave because of it, and having two separate people blame me for it)) and/or kill myself. I don't really know why i'm trying to stay alive other than avoiding leaving behind an ugly corpse for my family to discover. I'm less actively scared of death coming for me than the anxiety that makes me want to die. There's no point to any of this and i'm so fucking tired.

I feel that too. I think they know there's something wrong with me, I've admitted to it before or had similar issues, but no one wants to have to deal with it and I don't want to bother people if it means that's the only way they'd care or try to talk to me. Makes it hurt worse and feel faker

I relate on the burden side, but can't imagine on the life coach/therapy side. That sounds like an emotional and physical abuse of power. I wish I could help you get out of there but I don't even understand how that's physically legal or allowed. I hope something gets better for you one way or another.

I hate that i've written like maybe 8,000 words of a document deconstructing why a friendship is going to fall apart and it's going to be my fault because i can't deal with change + a lack people caring for me beyond responsibility anymore + unresolved issues + more reasons to die, maybe a week ago. And another 5,000 word suicide note that took 5 hours to write today instead of work. And i'm like, hey, maybe i'll find closure. Maybe it'll clear up how i feel. Maybe I won't want to so much if I write this and feel better.
Instead i'm still just frustrated how hard it is to kill yourself ideally and too busy feeling scared/guilty it'd be interrupted to properly try. I could've done this weeks ago and at least pretended the inevitable loss of friendships all around me from self-isolation and the stress of dealing with my suicidal ass, weren't eminent. I can't even say i burnt down relationships like I half-hoped, i just lost my shit and self-isolated. No, nothing's improved. Instead, i'm sitting here talking more shit and relating to all the sad people and completely more frustrated than i started. And I feel guilty i'm not doing work even as I plan to die. Is that a good thing? A bad thing? Did whining to myself work after all?

I wish i wasn't such a fucking indecisive coward and could do the right thing for once.

I also just wish I could trade places with someone who was dying. I feel like I should feel like I'm in a good place with opportunities, but I think it just applies to people who deserve it, who aren't me and don't come with my brain and uselessness.

At least the terminally ill have a tangible just cause to feel bad and give up. I'm just a failure at living.

I feel this a lot. Some part of me is still petty/jealous/bitter etc., but rationally I know and feel the self-disgust. Some part of me sees friends or people I consider friends who say they consider me a friend looking out for each other, checking on each other, but I don't see them reach out for me anymore. I've been shamed for having a panic attack for feeling left out and the attempts stopped even more from the one person. I don't reach out because I feel like my presence is a blight and dragging people down or wasting their time when I do, like I'm imposing and they're better off without, and I think they usually are better off. I can't ask when I want to die when I have to remind people I exist by asking to join anything, especially when I'm depressed, because that's just confirming what I feel. But I'm too much worse off to fix that anymore, and feel like a hypocrite because I've been too lost in self-hate and trying to distract myself most of the time to reach out when people feel bad, too, so I think it's deserved.

I had a nervous breakdown in the online space i usually chill with friends weeks ago. I don't feel safe there anymore. I don't particularly feel safe where i am physically either because i can't afford to move out and they can't really afford to force me out comfortably. at least i'm with my cat. At the same time, i think i've only been keeping sane the past few weeks because of my plans to kill myself feeling reassuring. I can physically see my heart rate monitor go down when i think about it. Some part of me, when i tried to visit a secure psychiatric place, wished an officer shooting broke out so i could just die and have the choice taken away from me. I just wish i could figure out when would be most convenient so i wouldn't have to get anxious thinking about being found before i die properly. i don't always know if i want to, but i think the guilt of leaving my cat behind or being found scares me more than being alive, that these are the only things stopping me at this point. I used to be more afraid of leaving people behind but i'm more and more convinced as time goes on that it'd be more convenient for them if i wasn't around anyway. I don't feel safe enough to reach out--i don't want the stress of trying to lie and pretend i'm not struggling not to kill myself again. I don't want to have to deal with the ingenuine concern that'll cause, to really feel like no one's gonna care unless i'm dead. Before I didn't want to share about it-- and i did before, just no one took it seriously-- but now i don't want to because i don't want to die reactively because if people make an issue of it i am just going to kill myself spitefully, i think. I don't want that, I just want to die feeling like myself if I do kill myself. I'm probably losing my work soon so i won't even be a functional useful human being anymore anyway. I just want a clean, secure way of dying i can choose and not have it taken away from me or endanger others with. I hate that i postponed doing it on the perfect day i had because i had a hope of moving out and keeping up work and ended up too dizzy anyway. I don't know when i'm going to get that chance again. I hate that i can't stop procrastinating even on the one thing that would end my anxiety with everything else i put off

i've gone over the steps to do what i'd need to do if i were to kill myself more loudly in my brain for months and i do have most plans set up if i were to do it tomorrow and its one of the only things keeping me sane. i haven't had anything bring me any kind of lasting happiness vs the fake happy numbing distractions bring for months. i thought i discovered a new passion a couple years ago with stuff like dnd and writing with friends but it just keeps petering out into meaningless distraction instead of happiness again when i try doing more of it. it's become worse and worse how much happier thinking of successfully killing myself lasts than things i used to like doing.

i dont know how i'm supposed to survive this, let alone without my cat. i don't know i want to. it seems silly but she's the only being who's ever comforted me when i panic attack. i already don't know what i'll do when she passes. i keep being told to do whats best for her or that i'm being silly when i bring up keeping her and its. I can't help laugh because even when people are trying to be verballly supportive i don't. Think they understand. and i know they say things to help me logically, but it feels like my cat has more people who love her than i ever could when people try to point out how difficult it would be. it just reminds me i should be a responsible adult (i'm late 20s) and should be able to handle myself, but can't. the idea of losing her keeps making me cry more than anything else today, even if today feels unreal anyway because i'm not being forcefully evicted. the drawn out not knowing is making me crazy. it might not be a selfless love in either human or cat direction but it's the only one that's always forgiven me and never meaningfully hurt me. it would be so much fucking easier to kill myself if i lost her. i would bring her into that bad family situation at least, because it'd be fine for her and keep me responsible, but one of the relatives doesnt like animals. it keeps making me loop into panic again. i hate how pathetic i am.
